entities.name: Gavi
entities.description: Human shaman on Ikoria who lives in the wilds of Raugrin as adopted mother to a brood of cat dinosaurs.

entities.name: Raugrin
entities.description: Monster-infested wilds of Ikoria where Gavi lives.

entities.name: Cat dinosaurs
entities.description: Brood of cat dinosaurs adopted and protected by Gavi.

events.summary: Gavi finds a newly hatched nest of cat dinosaurs whose mother was killed by a hunter, and the brood imprints on her.
events.quote: The mother cat dino had been killed by a hunter

relations.note: Adopted as surrogate mother by the litter.
relations.quote: she was adopted as a surrogated mother by a litter of baby cat dinosaurs
She is one of the few humans that had earned the respect of the planeswalker Vivien Reid
